title: MakiNuki SourceMetadata
description: Static JSON payload returned by the get_metadata() plugin export. The registry index.json entry extends this with distribution fields (see index.schema.json).

abiVersion.description: ABI contract version this plugin was built against; must equal the host ABI version at runtime

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. 'en', 'ja'; or 'multi' for multi-language sources

iconUrl.description: URL or base64 data URI of the source icon

nsfw.description: True if the source primarily hosts 18+ content

allowedHosts.description: Image/CDN hostnames the source uses beyond baseUrl; transport proxies may proxy these for the source
